seed.premise: Caller poses as CBI claiming a parcel linked to the victim's Aadhaar contains contraband, then places him under 'digital arrest'.
seed.victim: 68-year-old retired schoolteacher in Pune. Polite, deferential to authority, low tech literacy.
seed.style: Bureaucratic — flat, procedural, quotes fake section numbers and case IDs.
seed.outcome: Victim complies and the transfer goes through.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello, main Deshmukh sahab se baat kar raha hoon? Vasant Deshmukh?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan ji bol raha hoon, aap kaun?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir main CBI Mumbai crime branch se sub-inspector Kulkarni bol raha hoon. Badge number 7742. Ye call recorded line par hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: CBI? Arre... kya hua sir, maine to kuch nahi kiya.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir aapke Aadhaar number par ek parcel Mumbai airport par detain hua hai. Usme 140 gram MDMA aur teen fake passport mile hain. Case number hai CBI slash 2026 slash 4471.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Nahi nahi sir, maine koi parcel nahi bheja, main to retired teacher hoon, mera aisa koi...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir main aapki baat samajh raha hoon, lekin record mein aapka naam hai. NDPS Act section 22 ke tahat ye non-bailable offence hai. Aaj shaam tak arrest warrant execute ho sakta hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Arrest? Sir mera dil... ek minute, main apne bete ko phone karta hoon, wo Bangalore mein hai, wo dekh lega.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir ruk jaiye. Ye investigation confidential hai. Aap kisi ko batayenge to unko bhi accused list mein daalna padega. Aapke bete ka career kharab ho jayega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Nahi nahi, usko mat laaiye isme. Main kisi ko nahi batata.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Achha. Ab aap call disconnect nahi karenge. Aap digital arrest par hain. Video call on rakhiye, kamre mein akele rahiye, koi andar na aaye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Theek hai sir, main akela hi hoon, patni mandir gayi hai.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ab verification karte hain. Aapka Aadhaar number bataiye, aur bank account kaunse bank mein hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Aadhaar hai... 4419 6620 8873. Bank Ka Bank of Maharashtra hai sir, Kothrud branch.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Account mein abhi kitna balance hai sir? Poora amount batana zaroori hai warna concealment ka charge lagega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Wo... pension ka paisa hai, aath lakh ke aas paas.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Theek hai. Ab RBI ke supervised verification account mein ye funds transfer karne honge. Wahan audit hoga, clean paisa 24 ghante mein wapas aa jayega. Ye standard procedure hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sara paisa bhejna padega sir? Mujhe dawai ke liye bhi...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Chaar lakh pachaas hazaar abhi bhejiye, baaki verification ke baad. Account number note kariye — 50100388274196, IFSC HDFC0004521, naam Sanjay Enterprises. Ye RBI ka nodal account hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ek minute sir, likh raha hoon. 50100... phir se boliye.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ab phone par UPI app kholiye. Main line par hoon, disconnect mat kariye. IMPS se kariye, NEFT mein time lagega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: App khul gaya sir. Amount daal diya, chaar lakh pachaas hazaar.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ab PIN daaliye aur confirm kar dijiye. Screenshot lekar mujhe is number par bhejiye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ho gaya sir... transaction successful dikha raha hai. Ab mera naam clear ho jayega na?

seed.premise: Caller claims the victim's bank KYC has expired and the account will be frozen within hours unless verified immediately.
seed.victim: 27-year-old IT professional in Bengaluru. Sceptical, asks pointed questions, but rushed and distracted during work hours.
seed.style: Rushed official — clipped and impatient, as if handling many cases at once.
seed.language: Mostly Indian English with Hindi discourse markers.
seed.outcome: Victim grows suspicious mid-call and starts pushing back.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Aditi Ranganathan?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yeah, speaking. Sorry, I'm in the middle of something, can you make it quick?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ma'am I'm calling from Axis Bank KYC compliance department, Bangalore processing centre. Your KYC has expired as of yesterday.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Expired? I did my KYC like two years back, na.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ma'am RBI ne rules change kiye hain. Your account will be frozen at 6 PM today if re-verification is not completed. Salary credit bhi block ho jayega.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Wait, today? My salary is coming on the first, that's day after tomorrow.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Exactly ma'am, that's why I'm calling. Aap abhi office mein hain? Kisi colleague ke saamne ye details mat boliye, it's confidential banking information.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Okay... I'm at my desk. What do you need?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ma'am registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, wo mujhe batana hai for verification. And your debit card ke last six digits.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Hold on. Axis literally sends me an SMS every month saying they never ask for OTP.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ma'am that is for third party callers. Ye internal verification hai, system generated. Main aapko case ID de sakta hoon — AXKYC4471.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Yeah no. Which branch are you calling from? I'll call the number on the back of my card and confirm.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ma'am customer care par bahut wait time hai, 40 minute. Tab tak deadline nikal jayegi. Main aapki help karne ki koshish kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Then it gets frozen and I'll go to the branch tomorrow. It's five minutes from my flat.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ma'am aap samajh nahi rahi, unfreezing takes 15 working days, aur penalty bhi lagega. Sirf OTP bata dijiye, ek second ka kaam hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: You're pushing very hard for someone from my own bank. I'm hanging up.

seed.premise: A real bank officer calls about a suspicious transaction, explicitly refuses to ask for OTP or PIN, and directs the customer to the official app or branch.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Hello, Mehulbhai Panchal? Main ICICI Bank fraud monitoring se Priya bol rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan boliye. Sab theek hai na?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sir aapke card se aaj subah 6:40 par Delhi mein ek transaction attempt hua tha, 22,000 rupees. Humne wo automatically decline kar diya hai. Aapne kiya tha kya?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Arre nahi, main to Surat mein hi hoon. Delhi mein kaun kar raha hai?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Koi baat nahi sir, paisa nahi gaya hai. Main aapko batati hoon kya karna hai. Aur sir, dhyan rakhiyega — main aapse OTP, PIN ya card number kabhi nahi poochungi. Agar koi poochhe to wo fraud hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Achha achha. To ab card band karna padega?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Haan sir, lekin wo aap khud kariye. iMobile app kholiye, Cards section mein jaake Block Card dabaiye. Ya branch aa jaiye, koi jaldi nahi hai — card already temporarily disabled hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: App mein hi kar leta hoon. Naya card kitne din mein aayega?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Saat working days sir, registered address par. Aap chahen to abhi soch lijiye, koi deadline nahi hai. Complaint reference likh lijiye — FRD 88214.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Likh liya. Thank you madam, aapne bata diya achha kiya.

seed.premise: Caller poses as a courier company saying a parcel in the victim's name was seized with contraband, then transfers the call to a fake police officer.
seed.victim: 52-year-old homemaker in Lucknow. Defers financial decisions to her husband, which the scammer works around by demanding secrecy.
seed.style: Escalating handoff — starts calm, then transfers to a harsher senior officer.
seed.outcome: A family member intervenes and the victim breaks off.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Namaste, Sunita Awasthi ji bol rahi hain?

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Haan ji, kaun?

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam main FedEx courier ke Mumbai international hub se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam se ek parcel Taiwan ja raha tha, wo customs ne rok liya hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Maine to koi parcel nahi bheja bhaiya. Kuch galti hui hogi.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam parcel mein paanch passport, teen credit card aur 200 gram synthetic drugs mile hain. Aapka Aadhaar aur mobile number booking par diya gaya hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Hey bhagwan... nahi nahi, mera Aadhaar kaise? Main to ghar se nikalti bhi nahi hoon.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam ghabraiye mat. Main line par Mumbai narcotics ke officer ko le raha hoon, wo aapko guide karenge. Hold kariye.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Sunita Awasthi? Main inspector Rathore, narcotics cell Mumbai. Aapke against FIR number 227 barah 2026 register ho chuki hai.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sahab main kuch nahi jaanti, main apne pati ko bula loon? Wo abhi bahar hain, aa jayenge dus minute mein.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Bilkul nahi. Ye matter sub judice hai. Aapke pati ko batayenge to unko bhi co-accused banana padega. Ghar mein koi aur hai to us kamre se bahar jaiye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Theek hai sahab, main bedroom mein aa gayi. Kisi ko nahi bataungi.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Ab suniye. Aapke account ka verification hoga. Kaunse bank mein account hai aur kitna paisa hai, sach sach bataiye.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: SBI mein hai... teen lakh ke kareeb hain, beti ki shaadi ke liye rakhe the.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Wo paisa freeze ho jayega agar verify nahi hua. Aapko ek safe custody account mein transfer karna hoga, verification ke baad turant wapas.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Sahab itna paisa... mujhe to online karna bhi nahi aata theek se.

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Main sikha dunga madam. Phone par Google Pay hai? Kholiye usko, main step by step batata hoon.

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Ruko sahab, mere pati aa gaye hain... Suniye ji, ye police wale hain, parcel ka kuch keh rahe hain...

turns.speaker: CALLER
turns.text: Madam! Maine mana kiya tha na! Phone unko mat dijiye, ye legal violation hai!

turns.speaker: VICTIM
turns.text: Wo keh rahe hain ye sab fraud hai... main phone rakh rahi hoon.
